insights.pain: Carrier invoices are matched to purchase orders by hand in a spreadsheet every week, taking most of a day for two people.
insights.quote: Honestly it's all by hand. Every Friday two of us match carrier invoices against purchase orders in Excel, and at [company] that eats most of the day.

insights.pain: Matched invoices are emailed to accounts payable and re-keyed into the ERP, and items get lost in the handoff.
insights.quote: We email the sheet to accounts payable, they re-key it into NetSuite, and things get lost between the two teams.

insights.pain: Carriers send invoices weeks late, so the month closes with unaccrued costs.
insights.quote: And some carriers send invoices six weeks late, so we're closing the month with gaps. Last quarter that was about [amount] we couldn't accrue.
